title: AI-datacenter debt wave - off-balance-sheet SPVs + private credit (the leverage the capex hides)
source: Public record: Meta/Blue Owl Hyperion (Beignet Investor) announcement + 10-K footnote (E&Y 'critical audit matter'); Oracle SPV + $50B raise coverage; Sona Asset Management circular-financing map; FT/Axios/Benzinga. STRUCTURAL OVERLAY - all debt/$ figures are in notes; NO financial-core edges are added, so the proven capital-core SCC is untouched. HONESTY: deal structures, lenders, and the audit flag = fact; the 'circular financing' + 'hidden leverage' framing = analyst interpretation (Sona/credit desks), clearly labeled; figures vary slightly across sources.

edges.notes: Beignet Investor is the SPV for Meta's Hyperion data center, ~80% owned/managed by Blue Owl Capital, ~20% by Meta - the largest private-credit data-center deal ever (~$30B, Oct 2025) (fact).

Meta holds ~20% of the SPV, which OWNS Hyperion and LEASES it back to Meta - so ~$27B of underlying loans stays OFF Meta's balance sheet (only the equity stake + lease obligation appear). Meta's auditor Ernst & Young flagged the treatment as a 'critical audit matter' - among the most severe auditor warnings (fact of structure + audit flag; 'hiding leverage' framing = interpretation).

The SPV owns/builds Hyperion in Richland Parish, Louisiana - >4M sq ft, up to ~5GW, online ~2029, set to be Meta's largest data center; debt matures 2049, fully amortizing, rated A+ (S&P), ~225bps over Treasuries (fact; figures reported/vary).
Hyperion's ~5GW draw is itself a grid-scale load - the AI-datacenter power bottleneck at a single site (fact of scale).
Pimco (with BlackRock, Apollo, and others) provided ~$27B of the SPV's loans; Blue Owl put in ~$3B equity - private-credit + insurance money financing the buildout (fact; exact splits reported/vary).
Apollo is among the private-credit lenders in the Hyperion SPV - part of the Blackstone/Blue Owl/Apollo/Pimco/BlackRock cluster originating most AI data-center debt (fact).
BlackRock is among the Hyperion SPV lenders; separately BlackRock/GIP is a rumored SPV partner for Microsoft - the template spreading across hyperscalers (fact of Hyperion role; MSFT tie reported).

Blue Owl (with JPMorgan, ~$10B debt of a ~$13B SPV) financed Oracle's OpenAI Abilene TX facility (Stargate); Oracle also has ~$38B (TX/WI) + ~$18B (NM) off-balance-sheet SPV packages + plans a ~$50B 2026 raise - extreme leverage vs hyperscaler peers (fact; figures reported/vary).

Blue Owl/Apollo/Pimco/Blackstone/BlackRock are the private-credit originators behind the AI debt (loans to AI companies surged from ~0 to $200B+ in a few years) - the real-world counterpart to the map's SINK-lender financing layer (fact of category; mapping = interpretation).

Hyperion is the blueprint: off-balance-sheet SPV + private-credit debt + sale-leaseback that keeps hyperscaler credit ratings intact - now being copied (MSFT/GIP, Oracle/Stargate/Blue Owl, Google/TeraWulf) (fact of template; industry-wide spread reported).

The SPV is a pure AI-datacenter vehicle - a structure that moves the AI-capex debt off the tech balance sheet and into private-credit funds + insurance portfolios, redistributing (not removing) the risk (fact of structure; risk-redistribution framing = interpretation).
